digest.component_or_area: MCP server config ownership / seam cutover
propositions: Below-seam ambient config and credential reads in mcp_server.py and _mcp_auth.py must be routed through approved composition-root seam resolvers to comply with config ownership policy
Three new owned composition-root resolvers (mcp_gate, compose_config, read_secret_env) are added to config.py to replace direct ambient reads in MCP consumers
Per-request load_config() calls and os.environ.get reads for auth secrets must be moved to startup-time composition and threaded through the boundary
LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS entries for the two MCP files must be removed after reads are cut-to-seam, with check_config_ownership.py validating zero findings
Per-request semantics and secret value handling must be preserved; behavioral suites (MCP/auth tests) must pass unmodified after cutover
